declaration.preface:
Naxpar Pharma Pvt. Ltd. is committed to to minimizing its environmental impact and promoting sustainable development through responsible environmental management and continual improvement. As a manufacturer and developer of finished formulations in pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, herbal/ayurvedic products, and nutraceuticals, the Company recognizes that its activities interact with the environment and therefore strives to prevent pollution, conserve natural resources, and comply with all applicable environmental laws and regulatory requirements. With modern, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Naxpar integrates advanced technologies and professional practices to support environmentally sound operations.

This Environmental Policy provides the framework for Naxpar Pharma Pvt. Ltd.’s environmental objectives and targets, and defines the approach for managing environmental aspects across its operations. It guides employees, contractors, and stakeholders in incorporating environmental considerations into planning and daily activities, with the goal of improving resource efficiency, reducing emissions and waste, and strengthening overall environmental responsibility as part of the Company’s Integrated Management System
declaration.declaration: Naxpar Pharma Pvt. Ltd. is committed to protecting the environment by preventing pollution, complying with applicable environmental laws, and continually improving its environmental performance. The Company ensures responsible use of natural resources, efficient energy and water consumption, control of emissions and effluents, and safe waste management, while integrating environmental considerations and risk management into its business decisions. Through awareness, training, and stakeholder engagement, Naxpar Pharma Pvt. Ltd. promotes sustainable practices across its operations, and this policy is endorsed by senior leadership and regularly reviewed to ensure its effectiveness.
declaration.scope: This Environmental Policy applies to all operations of Naxpar Pharma Pvt. Ltd., including pharmaceutical formulation, cosmetic, herbal/ayurvedic, and nutraceutical manufacturing, as well as all supporting and ancillary activities related to production. It is applicable at all levels of the organization and across all business functions, and is supported by systematic monitoring, evaluation, and corrective actions to ensure the achievement of environmental objectives and targets.

Energy Consumption & GHG Emissions: Enhance energy efficiency by deploying energy-efficient motors, pumps, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and LED lighting across operations.
Assess and adopt cleaner fuel and energy alternatives where feasible to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
Monitor energy consumption through periodic reviews to identify reduction opportunities.
Encourage responsible energy-use practices through employee awareness initiatives.
Air Emissions Control: Ensure effective operation and regular maintenance of scrubbers, filters, and local exhaust ventilation systems to control process emissions.
Conduct regular stack and ambient air monitoring to ensure compliance with applicable air quality norms.
Minimize fugitive emissions through appropriate chemical storage, closed handling practices, and routine equipment upkeep.
Raw Materials Management: Improve raw material efficiency through batch optimization, yield enhancement, and standardized manufacturing processes.
Reduce material losses by strengthening inventory controls, storage conditions, and handling practices.
Promote optimized chemical dosing and evaluate substitution of high-loss materials where technically and regulatorily feasible.
Track raw material consumption trends to identify improvement opportunities.
Waste Management: Ensure effective segregation, treatment, and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
Minimize waste generation through adoption of reduction, recycling, and responsible disposal practices to support a circular economy.
Ensure safe management of hazardous waste via co-processing and incineration to achieve zero landfill.
Water Stewardship: Optimize freshwater consumption through process improvements, leak prevention, and efficient water-use practices.
Operate and continuously improve water recovery and recycling systems to maximize internal reuse.
Monitor effluent quality at regular intervals to ensure compliance with discharge standards.
Track water consumption data to identify conservation opportunities.
Promote water conservation awareness among employees and contractors.
Biodiversity Protection: Minimize operational impact on local ecosystems around manufacturing facilities.
Develop and maintain green belts with native plant species around manufacturing facilities.
Collaborate with local communities to support tree plantation, and clean-up initiatives that enhance awareness and conservation.
Responsible Product Use: Provide customers with clear instructions on safe handling, storage, and efficient use of products.
Offer technical support to help customers minimize waste, emissions, and resource consumption during product use.
Review customer feedback to enhance product performance and environmental compatibility.
Product End-of-Life Management: Facilitate safe disposal or recovery of expired or off-specification products through authorized facilities.
Encourage reuse or recycling of containers, drums, and packaging materials wherever feasible.
Engage customers and distributors on appropriate end-of-life disposal practices.
Periodically review end-of-life management processes to identify improvement opportunities.
Customer Health & Safety: Maintain high standards of product quality and safety monitoring.
Respond promptly to adverse event reporting and product complaints.
Promote customer awareness of safe handling and usage through training and guidance programs.
Employee Awareness & Engagement: Conduct regular training programs to build environmental awareness.
Integrate environmental responsibilities into SOPs and daily operations to promote sustainable practices.
Encourage proactive participation in sustainability initiatives.
Environmental Services & Advocacy: Collaborate with industry partners, regulators, and stakeholders to advance sustainability practices.
Engage suppliers and contractors on environmental compliance and responsible sourcing practices.

targets.target: Achieve 100% LED lighting coverage across all operations
Achieve 5% reduction in energy consumption
Reduce Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions by 5%
Complete replacement of 100% conventional motors and fans with IE3/EC units
Upgrade or retrofit 50% of existing air pollution control systems
Achieve a 5% reduction in process-related VOC and particulate emissions
Achieve a 15% reduction in raw material wastage per MT of formulations produced
Increase usage of environmentally friendly raw materials by 30%
Achieve zero landfill for all hazardous waste
Achieve 100% tracking and reporting coverage for all hazardous and non-hazardous waste streams
Reduce total waste generation per MT of production by 20%
Reduce total freshwater consumption by 45%
Recycle 60% of water from condensate, bottle washing, and DM plant rejects
Optimize and maintain closed-loop cooling systems to reduce cooling-related freshwater consumption by 25%
Plant and maintain 1000 native trees around company facilities
Conduct 2 community tree plantation and clean-up drives
Maintain 85% survival rate for all plantation and green-belt development activities
Achieve a 10% reduction in the lifecycle environmental footprint of key products
Achieve 90% customer compliance with sustainable and safe product use
Collect and recycle 10% of sold products/packaging materials through take-back programs
Ensure provision for 100% safe disposal of expired products through authorized waste management facilities
Conduct 2 customer awareness or training programs on safe product handling and use
Maintain zero product recalls or regulatory actions related to customer health and safety annually
Ensure 100% of products have accurate labeling, hazard communication, and up-to-date SDS
Conduct 3 training programs annually for employees on environmental and sustainability topics
Achieve 90% active employee participation in sustainability initiatives
Conduct 3 knowledge-sharing workshops or training sessions for suppliers and partners
Train 85% of suppliers on sustainability practices and environmental management

responsibilities.duty: Lead implementation of environmental programs, ensure compliance, and oversee monitoring, reporting, and training.
Integrate environmental objectives into operations and implement initiatives on energy, water, emissions, and waste.
Follow EHS procedures, use resources responsibly, and support sustainability initiatives.
Ensure product compliance with health, safety, and environmental requirements and manage product stewardship.
Comply with environmental standards and support responsible use, disposal, and sustainability efforts.

policy.monitoring: Naxpar Pharma Pvt. Ltd. regularly monitors its environmental performance across key areas such as energy use, greenhouse gas emissions, water management, waste reduction, and product safety. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are defined and tracked through internal systems to measure progress against sustainability targets. Performance is reviewed periodically by management to support data-driven decisions and timely corrective actions. Annual evaluations help identify gaps and improvement opportunities, with relevant information shared with stakeholders to maintain transparency and accountability. All monitoring and reporting follow applicable regulations and recognized industry practices to ensure accuracy and reliability.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Environmental Policy will be reviewed once in three years or earlier if required by the EHS Manager and updated as needed to reflect regulatory changes, industry standards, and company priorities. Updates are communicated to employees, contractors, and relevant stakeholders to ensure effective implementation. Revisions focus on strengthening environmental performance, improving resource efficiency, and driving continuous improvement across Company’s operations.
